BoundAttributes.Name: click
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: align
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the location for aligning Toolbar items on the Toolbar. Each command will be aligned according to the `align` property.
            The possible values for this property as follows
             `Left`: To align commands to the left side of the Toolbar.
             `Center`: To align commands at the center of the Toolbar.
             `Right`: To align commands to the right side of the Toolbar.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is Syncfusion.EJ2.Navigations.ItemAlign.Left
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: cssClass
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Defines single/multiple classes (separated by space) to be used for customization of commands.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ""
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: disabled
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies whether an item should be disabled or not.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: htmlAttributes
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Defines htmlAttributes used to add custom attributes to Toolbar command.
            Supports HTML attributes such as style, class, etc.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: id
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the unique ID to be used with button or input element of Toolbar items.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ""
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: name
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the unique name for each toolbar item rendered in Schedule. This name is used to map the toolbar items in the Schedule component.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ToolbarName.Custom
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: overflow
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the Toolbar command display area when an element's content is too large to fit available space.
            This is applicable only to `popup` mode. The possible values for this property as follows
             `Show`:  Always shows the item as the primary priority on the Toolbar.
             `Hide`: Always shows the item as the secondary priority on the popup.
             `None`: No priority for display, and as per normal order moves to popup when content exceeds.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is Syncfusion.EJ2.Navigations.OverflowOption.None
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: prefixIcon
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Defines single/multiple classes separated by space used to specify an icon for the button.
            The icon will be positioned before the text content if text is available, otherwise the icon alone will be rendered.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ""
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: showAlwaysInPopup
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Defines the priority of items to display it in popup always.
            It allows to maintain toolbar item on popup always but it does not work for toolbar priority items.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: showTextOn
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies where the button text will be displayed on popup mode of the Toolbar.
            The possible values for this property as follows
             `Toolbar`:  Text will be displayed on Toolbar only.
             `Overflow`: Text will be displayed only when content overflows to popup.
             `Both`: Text will be displayed on popup and Toolbar.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is Syncfusion.EJ2.Navigations.DisplayMode.Both
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: suffixIcon
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Defines single/multiple classes separated by space used to specify an icon for the button.
            The icon will be positioned after the text content if text is available.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ""
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: tabIndex
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the tab order of the Toolbar items. When positive values assigned, it allows to switch focus to the next/previous toolbar items with Tab/ShiftTab keys.
            By default, user can able to switch between items only via arrow keys.
            If the value is set to 0 for all tool bar items, then tab switches based on element order.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is -1
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: template
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the HTML element/element ID as a string that can be added as a Toolbar command.
            
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ""
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: text
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the text to be displayed on the Toolbar button.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ""
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: tooltipText
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the text to be displayed on hovering the Toolbar button.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ""
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: type
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the types of command to be rendered in the Toolbar.
            Supported types are:
             `Button`: Creates the Button control with its given properties like text, prefixIcon, etc.
             `Separator`: Adds a horizontal line that separates the Toolbar commands.
             `Input`: Creates an input element that is applicable to template rendering with Syncfusion controls like DropDownList,
            AutoComplete, etc.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is Syncfusion.EJ2.Navigations.ItemType.Button
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: visible
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies whether an item should be hidden or not.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is true
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: width
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the width of the Toolbar button commands.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is "auto"
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: allowVirtualScrolling
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It is used to allow or disallow the virtual scrolling functionality.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: cellHeaderTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It accepts either the string or HTMLElement as template design content and parse it appropriately before displaying it onto the
             month date cells.
             This template is only applicable for month view day cells.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: cellTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            The template option which is used to render the customized work cells on the Schedule. Here, the
             template accepts either the string or HTMLElement as template design and then the parsed design is displayed onto the work cells.
             The field accessible via template is `date`. It gets applied only to the view objects on which it is defined.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: dateFormat
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            By default, Schedule follows the date-format as per the default culture assigned to it. It is also possible to manually set
             specific date format by using the `dateFormat` property. The format of the date range label in the header bar depends on
             the `dateFormat` value or else based on the locale assigned to the Schedule.
             It gets applied only to the view objects on which it is defined.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: dateHeaderTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It accepts either the string or HTMLElement as template design content and parse it appropriately before displaying it onto the
             date header cells. The field that can be accessed via this template is `date`.
             It gets applied only to the view objects on which it is defined.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: dateRangeTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It accepts either the string or HTMLElement as template design content and parse it appropriately before displaying it onto the header date range.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: dayHeaderTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It accepts either the string or HTMLElement as template design content and parse it appropriately before displaying it onto the
             Year view day cell header.
             This template is only applicable for year view header cells.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: displayDate
BoundAttributes.Documentation: Specifies the starting week date at an initial rendering of month view. This property is only applicable for month view. If this property value is not set, then the month view will be rendered from the first week of the month. The default value is null

BoundAttributes.Name: displayName
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            When the same view is customized with different intervals, this property allows the user to set different display name
             for those views.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: enableLazyLoading
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Enables the lazy loading of events for scrolling actions only when the resources grouping property is enabled.
            Lazy loading allows the scheduler to fetch the appointments dynamically during scroll actions for the currently rendered resource collection.
            New event data is fetched on-demand as the user scrolls through the schedule content.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: endHour
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It is used to specify the end hour, at which the Schedule ends. It too accepts the time string in a short skeleton format.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is "24:00"
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: eventTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It accepts either the string or HTMLElement as template design content and parse it appropriately before displaying it onto
             the event background. All the event fields mapped to Schedule from dataSource can be accessed within this template code.
             It is similar to that of the `template` option available within the `eventSettings` property,
             whereas it will get applied only on the events of the view to which it is currently being defined.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: firstDayOfWeek
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            This option allows the user to set the first day of a week on Schedule. It should be based on the locale set to it and each culture
             defines its own first day of week values. If needed, the user can set it manually on his own by defining the value through
             this property. It usually accepts the integer values, whereby 0 is always denoted as Sunday, 1 as Monday and so on.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is 0
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: firstMonthOfYear
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            This property helps render the year view customized months.
            By default, it is set to `0`.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is 0
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: group
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Allows to set different resource grouping options on all available schedule view modes.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: headerIndentTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            The template option which is used to render the customized header indent cell on the schedule. Here, the
             template accepts either the string or HTMLElement as template design and then the parsed design is displayed onto the header indent cell.
             It gets applied only to the view objects on which it is defined.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: headerRows
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Allows defining the collection of custom header rows to display the year, month, week, date and hour label as an individual row
             on the timeline view of the scheduler.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: interval
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It accepts the number value denoting to include the number of days, weeks, workweeks or months on the defined view type.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is 1
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: isSelected
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: maxEventsPerRow
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the maximum number of events to be displayed in a single row.
            This property is applicable when the 'rowAutoHeight' property is disabled.
            This property is only applicable for the month view, timeline views, and timeline year view.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is Double.NaN
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: monthHeaderTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It accepts either the string or HTMLElement as template design content and parse it appropriately before displaying it onto the
             Year view day cell header.
             This template is only applicable for year view header cells.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: monthsCount
BoundAttributes.Documentation: This option allows the user to set the number of months count to be displayed on the Schedule. The default value is 12

BoundAttributes.Name: numberOfWeeks
BoundAttributes.Documentation: This property customizes the number of weeks that are shown in month view. By default, it shows all weeks in the current month. Use displayDate property to customize the starting week of month. The default value is 0

BoundAttributes.Name: option
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It accepts the schedule view name, based on which we can define with its related properties in a single object.
            The applicable view names are,
             Day - Denotes Day view of the scheduler.
             Week - Denotes Week view of the scheduler.
             WorkWeek - Denotes Work Week view of the scheduler.
             Month - Denotes Month view of the scheduler.
             Year - Denotes Year view of the scheduler.
             Agenda - Denotes Agenda view of the scheduler.
             MonthAgenda - Denotes Month Agenda view of the scheduler.
             TimelineDay - Denotes Timeline Day view of the scheduler.
             TimelineWeek - Denotes Timeline Week view of the scheduler.
             TimelineWorkWeek - Denotes Timeline Work Week view of the scheduler.
             TimelineMonth - Denotes Timeline Month view of the scheduler.
             TimelineYear - Denotes Timeline Year view of the scheduler.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: orientation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It is used to specify the year view rendering orientation on the schedule.
            The applicable orientation values are,
             Horizontal - Denotes the horizontal orientation of Timeline Year view.
             Vertical - Denotes the vertical orientation of Timeline Year view.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is Syncfusion.EJ2.Schedule.Orientation.Horizontal
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: readonly
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            When set to `true`, displays a quick popup with cell or event details on single clicking over the cells or on events.
             By default, it is set to `true`. It gets applied only to the view objects on which it is defined.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: resourceHeaderTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            The template option which is used to render the customized header cells on the schedule. Here, the
             template accepts either the string or HTMLElement as template design and then the parsed design is displayed onto the header cells.
             All the resource fields mapped within resources can be accessed within this template code.
             It gets applied only to the view objects on which it is defined.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: showWeekNumber
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            When set to `true`, displays the week number of the current view date range.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: showWeekend
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            When set to `false`, it hides the weekend days of a week from the Schedule.
            The days which are not defined in the working days collection are usually treated as weekend days.
            Note: By default, this option is not applicable on `Work Week` view.
            For example, if the working days are defined as [1, 2, 3, 4], then the remaining days of that week will be considered as the
             weekend days and will be hidden on all the views.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is true
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: startHour
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It is used to specify the starting hour, from which the Schedule starts to display.
             It accepts the time string in a short skeleton format and also, hides the time beyond the specified start time.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is "00:00"
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: timeFormat
BoundAttributes.Documentation: By default, Schedule follows the time-format as per the default culture assigned to it. It is also possible to manually set specific time format by using the `timeFormat` property. The default value is null

BoundAttributes.Name: timeScale
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Allows to set different timescale configuration on each applicable view modes such as day, week and work week.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: workDays
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It is used to set the working days on schedule. The only days that are defined in this collection will be rendered on the
             `workWeek` view whereas on other views, it will display all the usual days and simply highlights the working days with different
             shade.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: end
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It accepts the time string in short skeleton format `Hm` and usually denotes the end of the working hour range.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is "18:00"
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: highlight
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            When set to `true`, highlights the cells of working hour range with an active color.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is true
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: start
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It accepts the time string in short skeleton format `Hm` and usually denotes the start of the working hour range.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is "09:00"
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: content-template
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary> 
            To get or set value for ContentTemplate.  
            </summary>

BoundAttributes.Name: htmlAttributes
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Allows additional HTML attributes such as title, name, etc., and
            accepts n number of attributes in a key-value pair format.
            </summary>

BoundAttributes.Name: closeActionEvents
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the event to close the DropDownButton popup.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ""
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: content
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Defines the content of the DropDownButton element that can either be a text or HTML elements.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ""
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: createPopupOnClick
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies the popup element creation on open.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: cssClass
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Defines class/multiple classes separated by a space in the DropDownButton element. The
            DropDownButton size and styles can be customized by using this.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is ""
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: disabled
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies a value that indicates whether the DropDownButton is `disabled` or not.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: enableHtmlSanitizer
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Specifies whether to enable the rendering of untrusted HTML values in the DropDownButton component.
            If 'enableHtmlSanitizer' set to true, the component will sanitize any suspected untrusted strings and scripts before rendering them.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is true
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: enablePersistence
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Enable or disable persisting component's state between page reloads.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: enableRtl
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Enable or disable rendering component in right to left direction.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is false
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: iconCss
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Defines class/multiple classes separated by a space for the DropDownButton that is used to
            include an icon. DropDownButton can also include font icon and sprite image.
            </summary>
            <value>

            <value>

            </value>

BoundAttributes.Documentation:

            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is "stringedit"
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: field
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Defines the field name of column which is mapped with mapping name of DataSource.
            The bounded columns can be sort, filter etc.,
            The `field` name must be a valid JavaScript identifier,
            the first character must be an alphabet and should not contain spaces and special characters.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: filter
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>

            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: filterBarTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            The `filterBarTemplate` is used to add a custom component instead of default input component for filter bar.
            It have create and read functions.
             create: It is used for creating custom components.
             read: It is used to perform custom filter action.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: format
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            It is used to change display value with the given format and does not affect the original data.
            Gets the format from the user which can be standard or custom
            [`number`](https://ej2.syncfusion.com/documentation/common/internationalization/#supported-format-string)
            and [`date`](https://ej2.syncfusion.com/documentation/common/internationalization/#supported-format-string-1) formats.
            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

BoundAttributes.Name: formatter
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>

            </summary>
            <value>
            The default value is null
            </value>

TagHelpers.Name: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.TagHelpers.ScriptTagHelper
TagHelpers.Documentation:
<summary>
            <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.TagHelpers.ITagHelper" /> implementation targeting <script> elements that supports fallback src paths.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            The tag helper won't process for cases with just the 'src' attribute.
            </remarks>

BoundAttributes.Name: src
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Address of the external script to use.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            Passed through to the generated HTML in all cases.
            </remarks>

BoundAttributes.Name: asp-src-include
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            A comma separated list of globbed file patterns of JavaScript scripts to load.
            The glob patterns are assessed relative to the application's 'webroot' setting.
            </summary>

BoundAttributes.Name: asp-src-exclude
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            A comma separated list of globbed file patterns of JavaScript scripts to exclude from loading.
            The glob patterns are assessed relative to the application's 'webroot' setting.
            Must be used in conjunction with <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.TagHelpers.ScriptTagHelper.SrcInclude" />.
            </summary>

BoundAttributes.Name: asp-fallback-src
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            The URL of a Script tag to fallback to in the case the primary one fails.
            </summary>

BoundAttributes.Name: asp-suppress-fallback-integrity
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Boolean value that determines if an integrity hash will be compared with <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.TagHelpers.ScriptTagHelper.FallbackSrc" /> value.
            </summary>

BoundAttributes.Name: asp-append-version
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            Value indicating if file version should be appended to src urls.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            A query string "v" with the encoded content of the file is added.
            </remarks>

BoundAttributes.Name: asp-fallback-src-include
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            A comma separated list of globbed file patterns of JavaScript scripts to fallback to in the case the
            primary one fails.
            The glob patterns are assessed relative to the application's 'webroot' setting.
            </summary>

BoundAttributes.Name: asp-fallback-src-exclude
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            A comma separated list of globbed file patterns of JavaScript scripts to exclude from the fallback list, in
            the case the primary one fails.
            The glob patterns are assessed relative to the application's 'webroot' setting.
            Must be used in conjunction with <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.TagHelpers.ScriptTagHelper.FallbackSrcInclude" />.
            </summary>

BoundAttributes.Name: asp-fallback-test
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<summary>
            The script method defined in the primary script to use for the fallback test.
            </summary>

<summary>
            <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.TagHelpers.ITagHelper" /> implementation targeting elements containing attributes with URL expected values.
            </summary>
            <remarks>Resolves URLs starting with '~/' (relative to the application's 'webroot' setting) that are not
            targeted by other <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.TagHelpers.ITagHelper" />s. Runs prior to other <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.TagHelpers.ITagHelper" />s to ensure
            application-relative URLs are resolved.</remarks>

TagHelpers.Name: Bind
TagHelpers.Documentation: Binds the provided expression to an attribute and a change event, based on the naming of the bind attribute. For example: @bind-value="..." and @bind-value:event="onchange" will assign the current value of the expression to the 'value' attribute, and assign a delegate that attempts to set the value to the 'onchange' attribute.

BoundAttributes.Name: @bind-...
BoundAttributes.Documentation: Binds the provided expression to an attribute and a change event, based on the naming of the bind attribute. For example: @bind-value="..." and @bind-value:event="onchange" will assign the current value of the expression to the 'value' attribute, and assign a delegate that attempts to set the value to the 'onchange' attribute.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: format
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies a format to convert the value specified by the corresponding bind attribute. For example: @bind-value:format="..." will apply a format string to the value specified in @bind-value="...". The format string can currently only be used with expressions of type DateTime.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: event
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies the event handler name to attach for change notifications for the value provided by the '@bind-...' attribute.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: culture
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies the culture to use for conversions.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: get
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies the expression to use for binding the value to the attribute.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: set
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies the expression to use for updating the bound value when a new value is available.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: after
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies an action to run after the new value has been set.
